plainLanguage: Section 76 inafanya participation katika riot kuwa offence.
meaning: The section depends on the definition of riot in section 74(3). The prosecution must establish that the gathering had reached the statutory riot threshold and that the accused took part.
keyPoints: The person must take part in a riot.
The repository should not invent a penalty where section 76 itself does not state one; applicable punishment must be determined from the Code and other relevant sentencing provisions.

legalTerms.meaning: Unlawful assembly that has reached the section 74(3) threshold.

history.summary: Section 076 is recorded in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text verified before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The statutory definition should be applied element by element rather than from the label alone.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The nature of the gathering, common purpose, conduct and statutory threshold must be assessed from evidence and context.

debateQuestion: Je, facts zinatimiza exact statutory requirements zinazohusiana na section 076?
